payload.rationale: Brief sets journey_stage 'comparing', so per services.md the primary CTA is a Wedded Concierge consultation at /wonderland-concierge (live in link-map, default commercial CTA target). CTA text is 4 words, no exclamation mark, and avoids 'Speak with' because no call or phone option is confirmed. Subtext uses only the approved line already in 08-final.md (AUD quotes; fee and inclusions in writing before you commit); no fee model, deposit, price range, Wedded Privileges, named Advisor or call-booking claim, as these are deferred until the business confirms them. Panel: all five personas answered 'maybe'. What they want to see before the CTA is all business-owned and deferred: a real wedding at one of the villas (planner_couple), a rough 'From AUD' cost (planner_couple, search_visitor), how the fee works and whether commissions are taken (sceptic), a phone call with a named person (funding_parent), and a private or confidential enquiry route (uhnw). None can be added without inventing facts, so no copy change is requested now and the placement stays at the marker. When the business supplies these, the cro-specialist should revisit: a real-wedding link placed just above the primary CTA, and a 'book a call' secondary CTA if a call option exists. Lead magnet: /destination-wedding-guide is in priority-link-targets.md and the link map, and the Firecrawl scrape on 2026-10-21 returned 200 with the free 2026 download live, so exists is true. It covers 13 destinations including Tuscany but does not appear to feature Lake Como, so it suits only earlier-stage readers (search_visitor said they would bookmark rather than enquire) and sits last. Suggested magnet that does not exist yet: a 'Lake Como exclusive-use villa question sheet' (the comparison-table fields as a printable checklist to send each villa); the sceptic said they would share the post as exactly that checklist. Not placed. /magazine was not used because no Lake Como or Italy magazine edition is listed.
